caption: The drawing shows a rectangular object resembling a cushion or pillow with rounded edges, outlined and shaded in light yellow and beige tones. Placed centrally on the pillow is a decorative piece with an arching, ornate top edge, bordered in dark brown. This central decorative element has a red background and is adorned with an intricate symmetrical design featuring scroll motifs in white and light brown, floral decorations including a prominent red central rose joined by a purple flower, and green leaves. Additional small flowers in blue, pink, and purple, along with brown swirls, fill the composition. The bottom edge of the decorative piece has a thin light blue-white band bordered by a dark line. The background of the image is a plain off-white. There are stains visible on the left side of the cushion.
title: Embroidery on Pillow
